title: Software Factory News - Fri 13 Nov 2026
description: Friday's theme is coordination. Oliver and Sophie dig into Oussama Abid's measurements of 1,782 agent PRs under a deterministic lease coordinator ('a rule an agent has to remember is not a rule'), Christopher Weir's ringleader thread running ~90 Claude Code workers, ShopBack's Slack-based domain agents and their safety lessons, a ReasonOS vendor post on putting rules in the build rather than the prompt, the AgentRun Show HN and its comment thread on agentic merge queues for Dependabot PRs, GitHub's portable agent skills and a Proof Agent verifier that never sees the coding agent's self-report, plus fleet control planes and two GitHub changelog items. Each story is mapped to Andrew's Cursor/GitHub/Azure factory, ending with one practical idea: make staging-failure alerts durable until acknowledged.
